notes.title: The end is near. Thanks for your support.
notes.content:
It breaks my heart to write this, but I have to stop the support for Immune. I tried a lot of different ways to cover at least the server costs, but I failed.

I am sorry.

The servers will stay up for just a few more weeks before Immune goes out of business.

Thanks to everyone, that supported and played the game. It was an awesome experience nonetheless to develop this moonshot of a crazy game. :)

If you want to stay in touch, feel free to jump on our Newsletter, Discord, Twitter or what ever you fancy:
https://vidiludi.com/#contact

Thanks & Cheers,
Gabriel

notes.title: Player Owned Game Servers
notes.content:
Hello,

We want to give you a chance in hosting and administrating your own Linux Immune server, to open your region up for other Immune players. (Hello to all the new Brazil players from the last days!)

If you have a spare Linux Ubuntu server or vserver with at least 1 GB of RAM and if you are interested in hosting your own Immune server, please write to servers@immunegame.com with a short text about yourself.

We will give you the Immune Linux Server application and our official script to keep it running 24/7. Installing an Immune server only takes a few minutes.

Thanks & Cheers
Gabriel

notes.title: Immune Decay Update
notes.content:
Today's update changed the decay time for the following buildings:
- Wooden Door: 4 days instead of 2
- Metal Door: 12 days instead of 6
- Stone Wall: 12 days instead of 6
- Bed: 12 days instead of 6
- Loot Box: 12 days instead of 6
- Tesla Coil: 12 days instead of 6

TLDR: Most buildings will now last twice as long as before.

Have fun and happy new year!
Gabriel

notes.title: Immune Update
notes.content:
What's new in Immune:
[*] Medkits now heal over a short period of time instead of instantly.
[*] Medkits now heal 30% of health instead of 25%.
[*] Fixed bug where passengers were able to repair the car while driving.
[*] Tried to fix a rare bug where you could duplicate items.

Have fun playing. :)

notes.title: Immune 0.10.1b Server Optimization [UPDATED]
notes.content:
Today I tried to get rid of the server problems we experienced in the last 3 days. If you still run into problems playing on the official servers, please report the server here in the comments. Thanks!

I also fixed a bug, where you were able to repair your car while driving. ;)

Have lots of fun,
Gabriel

PS: Sorry for the server restarts and hickups in the last 2 hours. I hope I don't have to mess with the servers anymore.

[b]EDIT: January 17: The cause for the server problems has been found and fixed on the server side. Thanks for your help![/b]

notes.title: Server Problems
notes.content:
The last update causes the servers to fail sometimes.

If you connect to a server and you just see a NPC town with nights and days going by quite fast, then you connected to a dead server. You can report it here in the comments and I will restart it.

 I will try to fix this by Monday (tomorrow).

notes.title: Immune 0.10.0 Party Update
notes.content:
What's new in Immune:
[*]Added new party system (see communicator ingame). You can now share your tesla coils and doors with party members.
[*]You can now pick up items from containers with double click.
[*]Fixed "ghost car" bug, where you were able to repair an exploded car to make it reappear in a bugged state.

[img]http://vidiludi.com/gfx/immune_true_survival_party_system.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Immune 0.9.5 Repairing Update
notes.content:
What's new in Immune 0.9.5: 
[*]Removed singleplayer option for now, because it didn't work under some circumstances
[*]You repair any building (= buildings of your friends!) by attacking it with a hammer now (instead of pressing E)

[*]Increased hammer spawns (in shops and boxes)
[*]Added positive health indicators for repairing/healing
[*]Made explosives drops more rare

Have fun playing!
Gabriel

notes.title: Immune 0.9.4 Update
notes.content:
What's new in Immune 0.9.4: 
[*]Opened the whole map (new areas! yay!)
[*]You can now mute players in the "players online" overview
[*]There is a new button for playing singleplayer
[*]New "Building Repaired" message
[*]New players will start with 100% karma as "spawn protection" now
[*]Improved tutorial
[*]Fixed bug where some achievements didn't unlock properly
[*]Fixed bug where some houses didn't have colliders in the walls

Please let me know if you run into any issues with the new singleplayer mode! Playing singleplayer basically runs a local server on your machine that you automatically connect to.

New players left Immune too fast, because they were slaughtered at the exit of noob island. That's why I decided to protect them by making them saints right from the start. This is a test and might change again in future versions.

Tell me what you think about the new area! It's super hard but I think it became quite cool. :)

Have fun playing!
Gabriel

EDIT: Released 0.9.4b with a small patch for singleplayer mode.

notes.title: Next Update
notes.content:
Hey guys,

At the moment I am working on a small contract work side project, which was too tempting to turn down. That's why Immune development is very slow at the moment.

This will probably change in the next few weeks, so I can finish Immune's map. Immune will also leave Early Access soon, which of course does NOT mean that we are finished developing it.

We just hope that we can reach more players with that. :)

Thanks for your support and have fun playing!

Gabriel

notes.title: Loot boxes will be wiped tomorrow.

To fix the loot box bugs we need to wipe the items in them, so make sure you save your items in your inventory or by burying them in the ground.

Let's hope that tomorrow's server fix will finally fix this king of all bugs! It looks good so far. :)

Cheers

notes.content:
We finally dropped our price tag and went free to play as announced ages ago. We hope the servers will get more crowded that way, making Immune the multiplayer experience we wanted it to be in the first place!

Keep in mind that it's still in early access. If you have any feedback, please join the Community-Hub forums and let us know how we can improve Immune for you!

notes.title: Immune 0.8.11 All The Small Things Update
notes.content:
What's new in Immune 0.8.11:
[*]New hat case "Hat Case Flags"
[*]Updated Steam SDK to hopefully fix the SIGILL problem (also known as "can't find servers" or "can't connect to a server")
[*]Improved melee attack radius so it becomes easier to attack trees, trash bins and other resources.
[*]The camera zooms out (even more) when you drive in a car or move fast.
[*]New feedback messages for: - being blocked in a car - out of ammo - cant hurt saints
[*]Fixed bug where your karma display (name color and communicator) got out of date occasionally.

[*]Improved battle logging: your character now stays in the game for a few seconds if you kill the game process during combat.

notes.title: Next Updates Roadmap
notes.content:
Sorry for the delay guys and girls!
I had lots of work on my plate the last few weeks. Unfortunately not related to Immune. But this is almost done now, so it's back to business!

The next update will be coming in the end of April and this time there will be new enemies, new areas, new items and a few other things you can look forward to.

We also made a few new hats to fill up a new case full of pure awesomeness!

notes.title: Immune 0.8.8b Update

What's new in Immune 0.8.8b:

Have a great time playing Immune,

notes.title: Bugfix Server Update
notes.content:
Today I tried to tackle the bug where you weren't able to build and weren't able to exit cars anymore. I still don't know exactly how to reproduce the bug, so I changed some collision algorithms and hope it's fixed.

Please let us know in the Community Hub forums if you experience this bug again. On which server did it happen? How long did it take till it went by? How often a day did you experience this bug? Any idea on what could cause it?

We also changed the behavior when you exit the server while sitting in a car which can't be exited (because the exits are blocked OR because of the bug).
You will now exit the car exactly where the car was standing while the car will blow up without killing you. So if you reconnect, the car will be gone but your inventory items will still be yours. No more dying because of bugs! Sorry for that. ;)

Thanks for your help so far to hunt this mean bug down!

notes.title: Immune 0.8.8 Gold & Anti-Cheat Update
notes.content:
What's new in Immune 0.8.8:
[*]Gold nuggets are displayed in an own counter in your inventory now.
[*]Added new chat command "/dropgold 123" with 123 being an example of the amount of gold you want to drop on the ground.
[*]Fixed security holes where people were able to hack or to change their appearance to cars or other NPCs.
[*]NPCs don't pick up newly dropped backpacks anymore, so you may have more time to retrieve your stuff.
[*]You can build campfires in no build zones now.
[*]Fixed bug where you had a golden name but could still be attacked if your karma was 99% instead of 100%.
[*]Dogs won't attack saints anymore.
[*]Enlarged and added a few no-build-zones to avoid griefing of mission objectives and NPCs.
[*]Reduced damage of torch weapon (30 -> 20).
[*]Made Katana drops a lot less likely.
[*]Some NPCs decided to move away from Hometown (A), because it became too hostile.
[*]You gain karma 50% faster.
[*]You lose energy 20% slower.

Your gold nugget count is now displayed as a number in your inventory. That will give you more space in your inventory and your money won't be dropped completely, if you die!
However, 5% of your gold nuggets will be gone as fee for the resurrection.

[b]Make sure you drop your gold on the ground and collect it again to transfer it from your inventory to the new counter![/b]

Please leave a positive review if you enjoy Immune.

Have a great time playing Immune,
Gabriel

[*]Added anti spam functionality to the global chat.

[*]Reduces value of crafted objects to make them fit the reduced value of raw materials (from last update).
[*]Shops will resupply faster.
[*]Item collecting NPCs won't collect items in safe zones anymore.
[*]Vehicles don't get overproportional damage if they grind along a wall.

First of all sorry that the updating process took a good hour today. Some changes messed things up (which unfortunately was totally my fault). More content will be coming soon. I just wanted to get this update out real quick to solve some issues people had with their pings, griefers and spammers.

Please leave a positive review if you enjoy Immune!

Have a great time playing Immune,
Gabriel

notes.title: Immune Roadmap!
notes.content:
Hey guys,

We are still experimenting with some free 2 play mechanics and the Steam Inventory items to make sure we get a smooth transition to free 2 play in March/April.

Yesterday Immune's price dropped again to aaaalmost-free, which also removed the promotional hat. We will still keep the Steam Inventory item drops plenty until Immune gets free, though! So make sure you farm all the drops as long as you can. :)

Here is the Immune task board, where you can see what will come next:
https://trello.com/b/CRV1xeII/immune-survival-online-game

If you have some great ideas or feedback, please join the Community-Hub forums and let us know! Thanks to all the people who already contributed awesome ideas and bug reports!!

The next update will be a bit late, because we have some distractions going on in the next few weeks. Sorry for that, but don't worry. Immune is the best! Or will be ... some time soon. ;)

You may continue playing now.

Cheers,
Gabriel

notes.title: Immune 0.8.1 Steam Inventory Update
notes.content:
[b]How to get more concurrent players into Immune?[/b]

That question kept us awake for the last few updates, because Immune is most fun if played together with other people. After many attempts to solve this riddle, we now chose to turn Immune into a free to play game over the next few weeks. This probably is the only way for us to ensure Immune is the multiplayer experience we want it to be.

That being said, we won't turn Immune into pay to win. With this update we turned hats into Steam Inventory items instead of ingame items. You now get hats from cases, which have to be unlocked with keys. You have a chance of getting a case dropped when solving missions.

To thank all our players who already bought Immune, solved missions will also drop keys from time to time and you'll get much more drops. When Immune turns free, this will change and you'll only be able to get keys by buying them. The price of the keys will also rise.

Unfortunately we had to remove the ingame hat items to implement the new system. But now hats won't be lost if you die, so make sure you collect all the cases, keys and hats before Immune gets free. :)
 
[*]Hats are Steam Inventory items now! They can be traded, sold, bought or received from cases.
[*]Solving a mission now drops you a case sometimes, which contains one random hat. You can unlock cases with keys.
[*]Solving a mission now drops you a case key sometimes.
[*]Gasmask NPCs carry less powered weapons.
[*]Rebalanced all item drops. Weapons are more rare now. Trash bins and car wrecks drop more but less valuable items.
[*]Added name signs for cities.
[*]Made all trash objects slightly smaller (they were a bit too big).
[*]Made it less likely to get conditions on damage.
[*]Zombies are a tiny bit slower and deal less damage.
[*]Ammo and pill merchants in Hometown have more items in stock.
[*]Zombies and gasmask dudes do not drop raw meat anymore, because cannibalism is silly.
[*]Adjusted sound volumes for sounds like tire squeel, car crash and some others.
[*]Most of the food gives you more energy now.

Thanks again to everyone who supports us and to everyone who bought Immune! You guys are awesome and we will make Immune the best game possible for you.

Let's get some more people into the game, shall we?

Gabriel

notes.title: Immune 0.6.0 Karma Update
notes.content:
[b]What's new in Immune 0.6.0:[/b]
[list]
[*][b]New karma system[/b]
[*]You gain karma over time.
[*]You lose karma for attacking other players. The amount you lose depends on the karma of your victim. That means if your victim has 0% karma, you don't lose karma at all.
[*]Karma is indicated by player name color: red = bad, white = neutral, green = good, gold = saint 
[*]Players with 100% karma and golden names are called saints and are immune to damage from other players, but not immune to damage from cars.
[*]Killing / damaging players with your car will of course also decline your karma.
[*]Zombies and npcs don't push and block cars anymore. They get pushed away by the car instead.
[*]Fixed shooting trails going through walls while the bullets didn't. They now stop at the walls just like the bullets.
[*]Added help (press H ingame) texts for new karma system.
[/list]
